claycode.delta: Bounded DB transactions need no new DB-specific core primitive; implement typed transaction/resource API in stdlib/FFI, legality-checked lowering and receipts.

unifieddb.delta: Keep semantic transaction identity, runtime resource instance, backend transaction mechanics and durable receipt distinct; add stale capability/dependency epoch tests.

frank.delta: C9 authority/recovery boundary gains a DB-specific executable discriminator: source logical resource never mints execution authority; crash-before-commit rolls back.

harness.delta: Future Golden Trace: same semantic DB program; commit/rollback/idempotency/crash outcomes stable; absent/forged/stale resource denied; native-vs-WASI differential.

clayresearch.delta: Assimilated same-time loop transaction-envelope finding: dependency read-set plus capability epoch/validity should enter commit envelope; shared ancestry not replication.

claygraph.delta: Graph activation/relevance cannot authorize DB effects; any graph-selected transaction still crosses typed host resource boundary.

gwt.delta: DB commit success is not workspace uptake evidence; selection cannot mint resource authority.

hyperposition.delta: Alternative transaction intents must preserve distinct identities until selection/commit; no topology collapse into authority.

emergenz.delta: Transaction correctness and crash recovery are systems evidence, not emergence evidence.

global_invariants: semantic hash excludes ephemeral runtime handle
